jobs.title: CAD Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Team**

The Engineering Systems and Tools team designs, builds, and maintains the internal systems, applications, and infrastructure that power engineering across Anduril. We own the CAD, PLM, and engineering data ecosystem that every mechanical and electrical engineer at the company depends on to design, iterate, and deliver defense technology at speed. Our team sits at the intersection of engineering, IT, and product development — we don't just keep the lights on, we build the tools and architecture that make Anduril's engineering org faster, more consistent, and more capable. If you want your work to directly multiply the output of hundreds of engineers building autonomous systems, this is the team to be on.

### **About the Role**

The CAD Systems Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the enterprise CAD (Computer-Aided Design) ecosystem. This role bridges engineering, IT, and business operations to ensure CAD platforms, tools, and workflows align with organizational goals and support efficient product development. The architect serves as the technical authority for CAD strategy, governance, and integration across the organization, partnering with cross-functional teams to drive innovation, standardization, and operational excellence.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Evaluate emerging CAD technologies
* Develop long-term strategies for CAD infrastructure and integrations
* Support the establishment of CAD standards, best practices, and governance policies
* Design scalable CAD system architectures supporting multi-site collaboration
* Architect integrations between other CAD applications (MCAD, ECAD) and PLM
* Ensure interoperability across CAD platforms and file formats (STEP, IGES, JT, etc.)
* Partner with engineering teams to understand design workflow needs
* Work with IT to ensure infrastructure supports CAD performance requirements
* Provide technical leadership to CAD administrators and support staff
* Support CAD documentation, standards, and templates

#### **Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience with CAD systems in engineering environments
* 3+ years in a CAD administration, architecture, or leadership role
* Proven experience with PLM/PDM platforms (preferably Teamcenter)
* High proficiency in one or more major CAD platforms (preferably NX)
* Strong knowledge of CAD file formats, translators, and data exchange standards
* Programming/scripting experience (Python, C#, VBA, Lisp, or CAD-specific APIs)
* Experience with version control and system configuration management
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
* Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration abilities

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* Experience in regulated industries (aerospace, automotive, medical devices)
* Knowledge of MBD (Model-Based Definition) and MBSE (Model-Based Systems Engineering)
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications in CAD and generative design
* Experience leading enterprise-wide CAD transformations or migrations

At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

**About the Role**
==================

**Position Overview**
---------------------

This **AI/Data Science Engineer II** role is focused on delivering big-data analytics and AI solutions that drive decision support the business. This role bridges applied data science and advanced AI to enable smarter product design decisions and robust quality reporting and investigation support. The ideal candidate combines deep Python and SQL expertise, proficiency in statistical analysis and machine learning, along with a growing interest in GenAI-based solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with engineers and scientists to design and deliver analytical models, dashboards, and data pipelines that translate complex product datasets into actionable insights supporting product design decisions
* Apply Python-based data analysis and visualization tools (pandas, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc.) to develop scalable, reusable analytical solutions
* Design, build, and optimize SQL-based queries and data models across large-scale relational and cloud data warehouse environments, including ETL/ELT pipeline development and maintenance
* Explore and integrate AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Windsurf/Devin, GitHub Copilot) to improve development velocity and code quality, and prototype machine learning models to support predictive analytics use cases
* Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through polished visualizations, reports, and presentations
Contribute to data infrastructure strategy, including schema design, data governance, and warehouse performance  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related field
* **Experience:** 3-5 years (1-3 years if master’s degree) of hands-on experience deriving insights and driving decisions from large, complex datasets
* **Python:** Proficient in pandas, NumPy, and data visualization libraries (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly)
* **SQL:** Advanced proficiency - complex joins, window functions, CTEs, query optimization
* **Data Warehousing:** Hands-on experience with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS Redshift, BigQuery, or Azure Synapse
* **Statistics:** Solid working knowledge of foundational statistical concepts - hypothesis testing, distributions, regression, and sampling methods - applied to real-world product and quality datasets
* **Communication:** Ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable insights for cross-functional audiences
* **Data Pipelines:** Familiarity with ETL/ELT workflows and pipeline tooling
* **Cloud:** Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) in a data context

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Medtech / Healthcare:** Experience or genuine interest in medical technology, clinical studies, or healthcare data - strongly preferred
* **Data Storytelling:** A passion for turning complex data into compelling narratives that drive action - strongly preferred
* **Advanced Statistics:** Familiarity with advanced statistical techniques such as multivariate analysis, survival analysis, or statistical process control (SPC)
* **BI Tools:** Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar dashboard/reporting platforms
* **ML/Modeling:** Familiarity with scikit-learn or similar ML frameworks for classification, regression, or anomaly detection
* **AI Dev Tools:** Experience with AI-assisted coding environments such as Windsurf/Devin, GitHub Copilot, or similar
* **GenAI:** Experience in building production-level GenAI solutions to solve real-world problems

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Python / FastAPI)
jobs.description:
Rim Universe is building an AI-native platform for animated and serialized video content creation. Our platform helps creators transform ideas and scripts into structured production workflows, including story development, character creation, episode and shot planning, AI image/video generation, and editing.

We are currently expanding our engineering team and looking for a **Backend Engineer** to help build the core backend infrastructure powering our platform. If you're passionate about AI video creation, we'd love to have you join our team and help turn more great stories into amazing videos!

About the Role

As a Backend Engineer at Rim Universe, you will be responsible for building and maintaining backend systems supporting **AI model integrations, generation workflows, media asset management, and user/project data**.

You will work closely with our AI and product teams to build reliable, scalable backend services that support AI-powered content generation in a production environment.

Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services using **Python and FastAPI**
* Build and maintain **REST APIs** for our platform
* Integrate third-party APIs, including **LLM, image generation, and video generation models**
* Design and optimize **PostgreSQL** databases and queries
* Build asynchronous AI generation workflows, including task queues, status tracking, retries, failure handling, and webhooks
* Develop backend systems for users, projects, generated content, and media assets
* Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot services in **Docker/Linux** environments
* Improve system reliability, scalability, maintainability, and performance
* Collaborate with AI, frontend, and product team members to deliver production-ready features

Requirements

* **2+ years** of backend development experience, with at least one project taken through development, launch and ongoing maintenance.
* Strong **Python** skills and hands-on production experience with **FastAPI** or **Django**. Able to quickly read and maintain an existing codebase.
* Experience with **PostgreSQL**, database design, and SQL optimization.
* Understands how background job systems work: job state machines, **leases and heartbeats**, timeouts, **retries**, **idempotency** and **failure recovery**. Familiar with reliable messaging patterns such as the **transactional outbox**. Has used **Redis** (Streams, locks or queues).
* Experience integrating **third-party HTTP APIs**, including authentication, **async callbacks**, **status polling**, **rate limiting** and **error classification**. Understands why a **pay-per-call API** must not be blindly retried when the outcome of a call is unknown.
* Experience with **LLM API** integration, **prompt template** management or **agent** development.
* Familiar with object storage such as **S3** or **MinIO**: **presigned URLs**, uploads and downloads, and **access control**. Able to guarantee **multi-tenant data isolation**.
* Comfortable with **Linux**, **Docker / Docker Compose** and **Git**. Able to investigate logs, manage secrets, run backup and restore, and write tests for critical flows.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on work on **AI video, image or speech generation**, or audio/video processing; familiarity with **FFmpeg**.
* Experience with the **ComfyUI API** or building **multi-step generation workflows** (e.g. speech synthesis → video generation → lip sync).
* Experience building **Stripe** payments, subscriptions, credit ledgers or usage-based billing.
* Experience optimizing generation job performance, analyzing model costs or planning service capacity.
* Working knowledge of **Node.js / TypeScript** (our frontend BFF uses Next.js).
* Experience with global SaaS products.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of backend systems from maintaining through deployment.

You should think beyond simply implementing APIs and consider system reliability, maintainability, scalability, and production performance when designing solutions.

Rim Universe is moving quickly, so we value engineers who can work independently, solve problems proactively, and communicate clearly with the team.

Pay: $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Language:

* Mandarin (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Job Description

Job Announcement: Medical Assistant / Veterinary Research Technician

Company: California Medical Innovations Institute (CalMI2)

Location: San Diego, CA

Job Type: Full-time

Pay Rate: $25.00 – $30.00 / hour (commensurate with experience)

Start Date: Immediate start available / Available to start as soon as possible

Work authorization requirements:

Applicants with CPT/OPT are welcome, and H-1B visa support is available for eligible non-

U.S. candidates.

Green card (permanent residency) sponsorship may be o ered after three years of

employment if performance is outstanding.

About Us

California Medical Innovations Institute (CalMI) is a non-profit medical research

organization dedicated to translational research and medical device innovation across

multiple biological systems, including cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, lymphatic, and

endocrine systems. We are seeking a motivated Medical Assistant / Veterinary Research

Technician to join our research team.

Key Responsibilities

1. Surgical & Interventional Procedure Support

 Assist medical doctors, veterinarians, and principal investigators during acute and

chronic surgical, interventional, and catheterization procedures on large and small

animal models, including pigs, dogs, rabbits, rats, and mice.

 Prepare operating rooms, organize surgical trays, and ensure sterile fields and

appropriate instrumentation for cardiovascular, GI, lymphatic, and endocrine

studies.

 Assist in animal positioning, physiological monitoring (ECG, blood pressure, airway

dynamics), and anesthesia logging under veterinary oversight.

2. Pre- and Post-Operative Care Manage pre-procedure preparation, including fasting schedules, pre-medication

administration, and surgical site clipping/cleansing.

 Monitor animals during post-operative recovery, including vital sign tracking, pain

assessment, and administration of prescribed medications/treatments.

 Maintain clear and accurate surgical logs, recovery records, and medical progress

notes.

3. Daily Animal Care & Husbandry

 Perform daily animal husbandry, feeding, health checks, and behavioral observation

for research models in compliance with facility standards.

 Collect blood, tissue, and biological fluid samples following study protocols and

Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) principles.

 Support animal acclimation, handling, and habituation to minimize stress and

ensure study compliance.

4. Technical Support & Laboratory Maintenance

 Maintain, clean, sterilize, and inventory surgical tools, anesthesia machines,

monitoring equipment, and lab consumables.

 Ensure procedure rooms and holding facilities are sanitized and prepared in

accordance with institutional guidelines.

 Assist with specimen processing, tissue harvesting, and preliminary lab

testing/storage.

5. Compliance & Teamwork

 Strictly adhere to IACUC protocols, Institutional Safety Guidelines, USDA

regulations, and GLP standards.

 Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams including scientists, surgeons,

veterinarians, and laboratory personnel.

 Demonstrate flexibility in adopting new experimental procedures, handling various

species, and fulfilling additional operational duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements

 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Animal Science, Health Sciences, or a

related field. Availability & Schedule: Available for an immediate start. Weekend and holiday

work is required.

 Experience: Open to recent graduates as well as experienced candidates. Prior

hands-on lab or animal care experience is a plus, but comprehensive training will be

provided.

 Key Traits: Adaptable, eager to learn new technical skills, strong work ethic, and

attention to detail.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

 Exposure to animal allergens and repetitive motion.

 Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift up to 50 lbs individually, and team-lift up to 250 lbs.

 Required immunizations/screenings based on species exposure (e.g., Tetanus,

Rabies, TB, MMR, Hepatitis B).

Benefits & Growth

 Comprehensive Training: Extensive hands-on professional training provided.

 Benefits & Perks:

o Competitive compensation

o Medical, dental, and vision insurance

o Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) insurance

o 401(k) retirement plan

o Paid time o (PTO) and paid holidays

 Visa & Permanent Residency Support:

o H-1B visa sponsorship available for qualified non-U.S. candidates.

o Green Card (permanent residency) sponsorship available after 3 years of

employment, contingent upon outstanding work performance.

How to Apply

Interested candidates please email your resume/CV and a brief cover letter to

MWang@CalMI2.org. Please indicate your Work Authorization type and the earliest available start date in your application.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

* Build and maintain **REST APIs** for our platform

* Experience building **Stripe** payments, subscriptions, credit ledgers or usage-based billing.
* Experience optimizing generation job performance, analyzing model costs or planning service capacity.
* Working knowledge of **Node.js / TypeScript** (our frontend BFF uses Next.js).
* Experience with global SaaS products.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of backend systems from maintaining through deployment.

You should think beyond simply implementing APIs and consider system reliability, maintainability, scalability, and production performance when designing solutions.

Rim Universe is moving quickly, so we value engineers who can work independently, solve problems proactively, and communicate clearly with the team.
